items.label: Powerful 13th Gen Intel Core i3 Processor for Daily Tasks
items.value: Tackle assignments, presentations, and multitasking with ease. This HP 15.6 laptop features an Intel Core i3-1315U processor with 6 cores and speeds up to 4.5GHz, delivering responsive performance for study sessions and business applications.

items.label: Interactive 15.6-inch HD Touchscreen Display
items.value: Enjoy intuitive control with a simple touch. This touchscreen laptop features a 15.6-inch diagonal HD display, allowing you to pinch, zoom, tap, and swipe for a more natural and efficient way to navigate, sketch ideas, or browse.

items.label: Your AI Productivity Partner with Windows 11 Pro
items.value: Get more done with Microsoft Copilot in Windows 11 Pro for real-time assistance. Draft emails, summarize documents, or brainstorm ideas quickly. The professional OS also offers enhanced security and management tools ideal for both students and business users.

items.label: All-Day Productivity with Wi-Fi 6 & HP Fast Charge
items.value: Stay connected and powered. The latest Wi-Fi 6 ensures stable, high-speed internet for video calls and research. Work worry-free with up to 8 hours of battery life and recharge quickly—go from 0 to 50% in about 45 minutes with HP Fast Charge technology.

items.label: Modern & Portable Design with Enhanced Privacy Features
items.value: Video chat confidently with the HP True Vision HD Camera featuring a physical camera shutter and mic mute for instant privacy. This lightweight HP laptop (3.52 lbs, 0.73" thin) is built for mobility, easily fitting in your bag for campus or business trips.
